summary: Decision amendments are immutable successor packages on additive shadow-portable-audit-package/1.2 carrying a new signed member decision/decision-amendment.json (role: decision, contract: shadow-decision-amendment/1), bound via the existing manifest assets[] hash mechanism, linked via unchanged shadow-package-supersession/1 with exactly one new neutral marker DECISION_AMENDMENT.

options_rejected.A_extend_manifest_with_decision_fields: mixes business decision content into the integrity artifact; manifest churn for business vocabulary changes
options_rejected.C_separate_external_decision_contract: duplicates signing/verification machinery; breaks one-directory-is-whole-truth portability; danglable reference
options_rejected.D_supersession_vocabulary_extension_only: markers cannot carry actor, reason, target hash, or policy flags; closed key set would need reopening
options_rejected.E_evidence_event_extension: sealed bundles cannot accept post-hoc decisions; frozen event enum requires bundle_version bump and is already drifted 13-vs-18; reason text would be off-chain redactable

contract_changes.change: new additive version permitting role 'decision'; required when supersedes.marker == DECISION_AMENDMENT; 1.0/1.1 byte-identical and independently valid
structure unchanged; marker enum gains DECISION_AMENDMENT only; decision semantics never live in the marker
new member schema: target reference, decision payload, actor block, signed policy flags, status tokens, closed reason codes
1.2 successor mirrors supersession block as today; decision member listed in member_contracts

invariants: Override does not erase the original decision
Valid signature does not prove decision correctness
Package supersession does not invalidate predecessor evidence
package signer and decision actor are distinct concepts
no unsigned prose changes the effective decision
effective decisions are derived from the local package set only
